blackmage_intro: ^The air curdles. Violet fire gutters around a figure of tattered robes and a skull-topped staff.
^"Champions. How quaint. I have unmade gods — you will be a footnote."
^Mock him — "All that power, and still bound to this arena."
^Study him — read the currents of his magic.

c-0: ^His eyes blaze. Power gathers at his fingertips, far sooner than it should.
c-1: ^You see it: the dark recoils from holy light, and answers dark with contempt. Light will hurt him.
c-2: ^The Black Mage smiles, and the shadows lengthen. Battle is joined.
